notes: Task numbers are global across the five plans; ids are <subsystem>:<N>.
Deploy tasks (deploy:10-13, deploy:50-52) are never dependencies of build tasks; only deploy:52 (M3) blocks Step 3 submission. Keep dispatching build tasks while a human-gated task waits.
TRIPWIRE: if deploy:12 is not done by build hour ~5, stop and ask the user whether to downgrade to a local-only demo (also stop if the 45 s duration probe fails).
Timing flake rule: board:33, sort-report:36, deploy:50, deploy:51 retry once; two misses of 35 s -> AGENT_MODEL=anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 via env, never a flow rewrite.
board:33 and sort-report:36 run the live agent with the user's OPENROUTER_API_KEY from .env (key operation) -> human_gate.
Cut order if behind: stretch -> merge/delete polish (sort-report:37-38) -> CSV edge cases (sort-report:41). Never cut the money shot, the deploy skeleton, the report or the tests.
